title: automorphic-functoriality-transfers widget params
description: Bespoke functoriality-transfer picker for the automorphic-forms-adelic topic. Reader clicks a transfer arrow rho from L-group LH to LG in an SVG of the L-group correspondence diagram; the readout reports the induced action on Satake parameters. The clickable-arrow-on-L-group-correspondence diagram is specific to Langlands functoriality and does not fit clickable-diagram or clickable-graph.
